test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was the founder of Dharma Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Radhakant Deb**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dharma Sabha **was formed **in 1830 **in **Calcutta **by **Radhakanta Deb**.
 
• **The organization **was **established **mainly to **counter the ongoing social reform movements**.
 
• That was **led by protagonists **such as **Raja Ram Mohun Roy **and **Henry Derozio**.
 
• **Radhakanta Deb **always showed a marked **interest **in **promoting education**, particularly **English education among **the **Hindus**.
 
• He also **advocated female education**.
 
• **Radhakanta Deb **was actively involved in the establishment and activities of the **Calcutta School Book Society in 1817 **and the **Calcutta School Society in 1818**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Debendranath Tagore **was an **Indian Hindu philosopher **and **religious reformer**, active in the **Brahmo Samaj**. He joined **Brahmo samaj **in **1842**. He was **the founder in 1848 **of the **Brahmo religion**.
 
• **Pandit Tulsi Ram Sharma **was an **Indian politician **who served as the **speaker of the Himachal Pradesh Legislative Assembly **in India. He was **elected **as **MLA from Bharmour constituency **on the **ticket of Bharatiya Janata Party **in **1990, 1998, and 2000**.
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy **the **founder of the Brahmo Samaj **(one of the first Indian socio-religious reform movements) was a **great scholar **and an **independent thinker**. He was **a religious **and **social reformer **and is known as the **'Father of Modern India' **or **'Father of the Bengal Renaissance**'.
